text.title: Rhyme Scheme Compliance
text.declared_genre: Experimental Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Folk / Spoken Word
text.declared_mood: Dry, playful, irritated, self-aware → expansive, defiant, quietly transcendent
text.production_notes: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar with odd accents, muted kick, brushed snare, hand taps, upright-style bass, Sparse piano, detuned room harmonium, and small percussive objects, Experimental dropouts before punchlines, Triplet sections get tighter drums and tapping guitar body, Final third widens with ghostly harmonies and uneven claps, staying raw and intimate,
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male vocal, Conversational spoken-word verses with sudden fast triplet runs and dense internal rhymes, Dry comic timing, close-mic asides, whispered doubles on refrains, Hooks half-sung, fragile but sarcastic, Starts like a lecture gone wrong, then opens into something stranger and more sincere,

transcription.text: Apparently. It has to rhyme. That's the rule. A song is not a song unless the last word. Shakes hands with another last word. Wearing the same hat. Obviously. I was told the line was broken because it didn't close its mouth right. Didn't land and eat little shoes at the end of a hallway under fluorescent judgment. I said, maybe the step is to the point. They said, no, no, no, where's the rhyme? As if meaning is a receipt and the rhyme is the stamp. As if grief has to couplet before it's allowed in the camp. They want the ending to click like cutlery and a drawer. I want the sentence to hover like it forgot what floors are for. Take any time with this illable symmetry little committee. We're bitter validity checking the ending for audible chemistry. Missing the middle entirely. Give it a pattern, a ladder, a battery. Make it all glitter with glitter with flattery. No, I'd rather let rhythm unravel me half. The magic is fallibility. Maybe it rhymes, maybe it doesn't. Maybe the silence is part of the sentence. Maybe the shape is changing its mind. Maybe the music is not in the line. It doesn't have to rhyme to arrive. Doesn't need a perfect little ending to survive. If the feeling bends to frame. If the breath still finds the flame. It doesn't have to rhyme to be alive. Though admittedly, that one did for accessibility. I once ended an album by refusing to stay solid. Seven little rooms for one unstable body. Superposition in the hallway, double slit memory. Every gaze made a version that pretended to be me. I was trying to say, I changed when I'm witness. I shrink when I'm measured. I averaged when I'm questioned. I become more convenient when the room needs a shape. Then dissolve in the silence when there's no ability to play cape. Someone heard all that and said, cool, does it rhyme, though? What? Which is funny in a small, tired, tragic way. Like watching someone stare at a stained glass window. And ask if it comes in beige. Riddle in the middle with the flicker and the fission. Little bit of vision and a split of recognition. The repetition is in a position. Agism is a lack of composition. But the pulse and the pulse across the clause. It draws a lot with draws. When a clean little scheme gets mean. It gets small. I'd rather leave the rhyme outside in the hall. It doesn't have to rhyme to arrive. It doesn't need a perfect little ending to survive. If the feeling bends the frame of the line. If the breath still finds the flame. It doesn't have to rhyme to be alive. I get the comfort. A rhyme is a little promise. That the world has corners. A tiny door clicking shut. A pair of hands saying, there that belongs. And after enough years of not belonging anywhere. I understand the appeal of a lock that works. But sometimes the line doesn't want a lock. Sometimes it wants a window. Sometimes it trails off before it lies. Sometimes the most honest ending is the one that refuses. To decorate itself. But the committee. So though I don't hate rhyme. I like rhyme. It's a small dog with excellent timing. But I don't trust any rule that mistakes. Obedience for music. I don't trust any listener. Who counts the matching sounds. But this is the mouth trembling. I don't trust the neatness that I still. Restranged in the comments here before. Entering the room because I have tried that. I have collapsed for comfort. I have answered correctly. And felt myself disappear. I made myself pleasurable to people who only wanted. A smaller version of the truth. Cluttered on pattern, the clatter gets lighter. Until the whole matter was battered. A patch and true bummer. The armor alarmer will shant a lear hanging. We're visually standing sincerely. I can do clever forever whatever we seek. Internal external and chroming geometry. But if the little trick covers the injury. That isn't craft. That's just pretty. No. Bad habit. Try again. That's the thing. I keep trying again. It doesn't have to rhyme to arrive. It doesn't need a perfect little ending to survive. If the feeling bends the frame. If the breath still finds the flame. It doesn't have to rhyme to be lied. The confrontor we can strike. We can leave it for the antlers to stay. If the truth comes out strange. Let it change. Let it change. Yes. Some songs arrive. Some songs don't. Some songs almost do. Then think better. Some songs are still becoming. They do stop. Listening. And some songs. If left unobserved. Finally remember. How to be. How to be.

SC_structural_coherence.reason: Section lengths are proportionate, but transitions feel designed rather than DAW-copy-paste. The form is clean with a clear arc, but the final third lacks a strong outro function.

MI_motivic_integration.reason: Motifs recur across sections but are mostly transformed (pitch, rhythm, timbre) rather than deeply integrated. Cross-domain recursion is limited, and the track lacks a strong motif web.

BP_beauty_spatial_poise.reason: Sonic habitat is consistently beautiful and coherent, with intentional use of reverb, delay, and stereo field. The production remains intimate and spacious even during emotionally intense moments.

EG_evolving_grammar.reason: The grammar evolves meaningfully over time, with shifts in density, rhythm, and harmonic color. The beat and harmonic bed show subtle variation, and the flow grammar adapts to emotional hinges.

CD_carry_depth.reason: The track defines a recognisable emotional habitat and invites re-listening. It feels like a little world with a clear arc and emotional depth.
